title: Fisherman's Wharf

services.name: Full Day Fishing
services.desc: Our private charters are designed to provide all the fun and adventure of our daily full and half-day fishing trips but geared for people who want the entire boat for themselves and their party. We can accommodate up to 120 people on these charters and they are perfect for family reunions, corporate events, team building, school field trips, educational programs and much more. On these trips, you can expect extra levels of personal service and attention plus a one-of-a-kind, fun-filled day of memories. Oh, and great fishing too! services.name: Seal And Whale Tour
services.desc: The same beautiful waters that offer great sportfishing action also provide the perfect backdrop to watch sleek dolphins doing what they seem to do best: have fun! Always playful and ready to put on a show, dolphins are often seen during these trips, racing the boat, jumping its wake and seemingly dancing across the waves. If you're into a little light-hearted, feel-good fun, a dolphin watch cruise might just be what you're looking for. services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: One of our Sunset Cruises is a perfect way to cap off your day and stay when you're in Lewes. Whether you've been on the beach all day, shopping and sightseeing downtown, taking a hike through Cape Henlopen State Park, or doing any other of the things this area is famous for, kicking back and taking in the sites and sounds of the sea while doing absolutely nothing else will remind you just how good vacation can be. Be mesmerized by the approximately 2 hour sunset on the water: Memorial Day weekend through August 9 departing at 7:00 p.m. After Labor Day- Friday, Saturday, and Sunday departing at 6:00 p.m. until the end of September.
